name: vibe-coding-learning-command-centre
description: Local dashboard tracking a 12-week Vibe Coding curriculum: coverage, transcript evidence and verified mastery.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
